text: Run multiple autonomous agents in parallel across separate, independent projects
quote: Orchestrate multiple autonomous agents working in parallel across independent projects.

text: Define a cron schedule so agents start and run automatically in the background
quote: Automate routine checks with Scheduled Tasks, simply define a cron schedule and the agents start and run autonomously in the background.

text: Speak prompts aloud and have them transcribed into clear text prompts via Gemini Audio
quote: Speak your prompts. Powered by the latest Gemini Audio models, real-time transcription converts conversational speech into clearly phrased prompts.

text: Create or download custom skill packages that extend agent autonomy
quote: Create or download fully customizable skills to further your agent’s autonomy and transform how you get work done.

text: Group conversations into Projects spanning multiple folders with scoped permissions
quote: Group your conversations into Projects, which can span multiple folders and support custom settings and scoped permissions.

text: Editor offers tab autocompletion and natural-language code commands
quote: Google Antigravity's Editor view offers tab autocompletion, natural language code commands, and a configurable, and context-aware configurable agent.

text: Agents can autonomously act across the editor, terminal, and browser
quote: Able to autonomously operate across your editor, terminal, and browser.

text: Give inline comments/feedback on generated Artifacts to guide the agent
quote: Leave comments and feedback on any Artifact to better guide the Agent.

text: Edit, orchestrate, and build entirely through natural-language instructions to agents
quote: Edit, orchestrate, and build all in natural language. Tell your agents what you need, and they’ll work on getting it done.

text: Run multiple agents in parallel to speed up completion of larger tasks
quote: Have multiple agents working in parallel, so larger tasks get tackled faster.

text: Navigate and customize the tool via terminal slash-commands like /config and /keybindings
quote: Navigate your entire workflow via standard terminal shortcuts: adjust permissions, themes, and preferences via /config and type /keybindings to customize every shortcut.

text: Quickly access plugin, MCP, skill, and hook configuration via slash commands
quote: Access plugins, MCP, skills, and hooks configurations instantly via slash commands, quickly enhancing your workflow.

text: Agent SDK exposes the same tools, agent loop, and context management programmatically in Python
quote: The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Google Antigravity, programmable in Python.

text: Layer custom Python functions and MCP servers over built-in filesystem/terminal tools in one pipeline
quote: Layer custom Python callables, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and reusable agent skills over our built-in filesystem and terminal tools under a single pipeline.

text: Attach multimedia files (images, video, audio, documents) alongside text prompts for the agent
quote: Pass rich multimedia file attachments (images, videos, audio, and documents) to the agent alongside textual instruction prompt lists.

text: Select which reasoning model powers a session from a model dropdown
quote: Users can select which reasoning model they want to use within the model selector drop-down under the conversation prompt box

text: A Project can include one or multiple folders (e.g., frontend and backend repos) for full codebase context
quote: a project can work with one folder or multiple folders (e.g., a frontend and a backend repo), providing your agents with all of the context required for your codebase

text: An agent can delegate tasks like running tests or codebase searches to dedicated subagents
quote: an agent can delegate tasks—such as running tests or performing extensive codebase searches—to dedicated subagents.

text: Ships with several specialized subagents pre-packaged out of the box
quote: Antigravity comes pre-packaged with several specialized subagents out of the box

text: A skill is defined as a folder with a SKILL.md file of task-specific instructions the agent follows
quote: A skill is a folder containing a `SKILL.md` file with instructions that the agent can follow when working on specific tasks.

text: Hooks let you run custom scripts or shell commands at specific points in the agent's execution loop
quote: Hooks allow you to run custom scripts or shell commands at specific points during Antigravity’s execution loop.

text: MCP lets Antigravity fetch structured context or execute safe actions on the user's behalf
quote: MCP lets Antigravity fetch structured context directly or execute safe actions on your behalf when needed.

text: Permissions are controlled via Deny, Ask, and Allow access lists for agent actions
quote: Permissions are evaluated across three distinct access lists: Deny... Ask... Allow

text: Planning Mode has the agent produce structured implementation plans (Artifacts) before executing
quote: Planning Mode: The agent plans thoroughly before executing tasks... produces structured implementation plans called Artifacts

text: Agent always pauses and requires explicit user approval before applying proposed changes
quote: The agent always halts and requests your explicit approval before proceeding with proposed changes.

text: Remote Control lets you securely connect to and drive desktop agent sessions from any web browser
quote: Antigravity Remote Control allows you to securely connect to and drive your Antigravity 2.0 desktop sessions running across your machines from any web browser.

text: Rules can be activated Manually, Always On, by Model Decision, or via Glob patterns
quote: At the rule level you can define how a rule should be activated: Manual... Always On... Model Decision... Glob

text: Plugins bundle skills, rules, MCP servers, and hooks into a single namespaced package
quote: Plugins are namespaced bundles that allow you to extend Antigravity’s capabilities by grouping skills, rules, MCP servers, and hooks into a single package.

text: Telemetry sharing of interaction logs can be toggled on or off
quote: toggle Telemetry (enable/disable sharing interaction logs to improve models)

text: Artifacts include markdown implementation plans, code diffs, architecture diagrams, images, and browser recordings
quote: Artifacts include rich markdown plans (Implementation Plans), code diffs, architecture diagrams, images, and browser recordings.

text: Provide inline text feedback to steer the agent before it modifies local files
quote: you can provide inline text feedback to steer the agent’s thinking in the proper direction before it modifies any local files

text: External files like Google Drive links, PDFs, and Office docs appear in a dedicated Documents sidebar section
quote: External files such as Google Drive links, PDFs, and Office documents now appear in their own Documents section in the sidebar above Artifacts.

text: Diff viewer supports hiding whitespace-only changes when reviewing code
quote: Added a "Hide Whitespace Changes" option to the Review Changes overflow menu and file diff viewers to filter out whitespace-only edits.

text: Code and data files (e.g., SQL, JSONL) open in a virtualized viewer with syntax highlighting and line numbers
quote: Code and data artifacts like SQL and JSONL files now open in a virtualized viewer with syntax highlighting and line numbers

text: Projects define the folder and repository boundaries agents are allowed to access
quote: Agents work within Projects, which define the boundaries of the folders and repositories they can access.

text: Serves as a central command center to launch, monitor, and orchestrate AI agent activity
quote: Antigravity 2.0 serves as your AI agents’ central command center, providing a unified platform to launch, monitor, and orchestrate their activities.

text: Projects natively support Git worktrees, letting agents work in isolated background folders
quote: Worktree support: Projects natively support Git worktrees, allowing agents to operate in isolated background folders.

text: Users can schedule messages to be sent to their agents while away
quote: users can schedule messages to be sent to their agents while they’re away
